techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution to interact with systems and hide malicious activity.
techniques.detection_focus: Process command lines with -EncodedCommand, -WindowStyle Hidden, -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, and WebClient downloads.

techniques.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
techniques.description: Adversaries may use SMB to interact with administrative shares (ADMIN$, C$, IPC$) to execute commands remotely.
techniques.detection_focus: Network logons (Event 4624 Type 3), PsExec service installations (Event 7045), and IPC$ tree connects.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate stolen data by transferring it over the existing command and control channel.
techniques.detection_focus: High-volume outbound HTTP POST requests, encrypted TLS payloads to non-reputable IPs, and anomalous DNS TXT queries.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to access credential material stored in the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process memory.
techniques.detection_focus: Process access handles requesting PROCESS_VM_READ to lsass.exe (Sysmon Event 10) and Mimikatz script execution.

techniques.name: Data Staged: Local Data Staging
techniques.description: Adversaries may stage collected data in a central location prior to exfiltration.
techniques.detection_focus: Creation of password-protected .zip, .7z, or .rar archives in %TEMP% or public user directories.
